responsibility: This source file implements the function_base expansion logic for the base set of AArch64 SVE ACLE intrinsics. It defines the operation-specific expander classes and helpers that map resolved intrinsic calls onto RTL instructions or optabs, handling predication variants, lane forms, reductions, addressing forms, floating-point unspec selection, and other SVE semantic details for the non-SVE2 intrinsic set described by the SVE builtin tables.
same_name_distinction: Within the aarch64-sve-builtins-base trio, this is the semantic implementation file: it defines the function_base expanders and helper code that turn the base SVE intrinsic families into RTL/optab operations, whereas the .def file merely lists those families declaratively and the .h file only declares the exported function_base objects.
